def test(page):
    ed = "net.gsantner.markor:id/document__fragment__edit__highlighting_editor"
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").to_be_visible(precondition=True)
    page.get_by_role("paragraph", name="atlas").to_have_text("atlas", precondition=True)
    page.get_by_role("textbox", name=ed).click()
    page.type_text("Bring the blue notebook.")
    page.get_by_role("textbox", name=ed).to_have_text("Bring the blue notebook.")
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
    page.reload()
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").to_be_visible(precondition=True)
    page.get_by_role("textbox", name=ed).to_have_text("Bring the blue notebook.")

- **Precondition:** it checks that the Search button and the `atlas` title are visible.
- **Action:** it taps the editor, types `Bring the blue notebook.`, asserts the editor holds that text, and taps Save.
- **Reopen:** it calls `page.reload()`, checks the Search button is visible again, and asserts the editor still holds `Bring the blue notebook.`

One thing to know: the test counts a reload as closing and reopening the app. In my manual run the app came back with `atlas` open in the editor, so the final check reads the text there.
